{{Quote|I had never encountered a Wol Cabasshite before. Master Omo's cognitive brain, as opposed to the one that controlled his digestive tasks, was so highly evolved and alien from mine that his musings were often indecipherable.|Saesee Tiin remembers Omo Bouri|<ref name="JVS" />}}
'''Omo Bouri''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wol Cabasshite/Legends|Wol Cabasshite]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During his tenure in the Order, Bouri sat on the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]].

Bouri trained the [[Iktotchi/Legends|Iktotchi]] [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]] as his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], and would die in [[42 BBY/Legends|42 BBY]]. He was given a [[Funeral of Omo Bouri|funeral]] where Tiin refrained from eulogizing.

==Biography==
Omo Bouri was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wol Cabasshite/Legends|Wol Cabasshite]] [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] as a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Bouri successfully negotiated the [[Treaty of Trammis]] in [[124 BBY]]<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>, glorifying him in the records of the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]].<ref name="TNEGTC" /> Once Bouri had attained the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], he was asked to sit on the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|High Council]] and served in this position some time between [[115 BBY|115]] and [[103 BBY]].<ref name="TJP">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref>

While on the High Council, Bouri took the [[Iktotchi/Legends|Iktotchi]] [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]] as his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]]. Training Tiin to knighthood, Bouri's Padawan would eventually sit on the High Council himself.<ref name="TNEGTC" /> In a particular copy of the third edition of ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]'', [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiate]] [[Thame Cerulian]] made a note regarding Master Bouri, claiming that he was far superior in the sport of [[Smashball/Legends|smashball]] than the Wol Cabasshite Jedi.<ref name="TJP" />

Bouri [[Death/Legends|died]] in [[42 BBY/Legends|42 BBY]], remembered by his fellow Jedi for his years of service to the Order. Tiin had a difficult time with Bouri's passing, spending much of the next twenty years attempting to contact the [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]] of his departed Master through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], but was never successful. Thus preoccupied, Tiin never took a Padawan of his own, and his usefulness on the Council was sometimes questioned prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="TNEGTC" />
